item: Spark plugs matched to each ATV model
rationale: The ATV fleet on arrival had one working vehicle; over 3 pre-sim days the crew replaced spark plugs among other fixes before all 5 started by Day 3. The brief's lesson is to bring spark plugs matched to the models.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.1 Technical failures, lines 542-547, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 72
